queryLines: WITH pipes AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, name AS pipeline_name, concat('', coalesce(name, pipeline_id), '') AS pipeline_link, pipeline_type, CASE WHEN tags IS NULL OR cardinality(tags) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE transform(map_entries(tags), e -> concat(e.key, CASE WHEN e.value IS NULL OR e.value = '' THEN '' ELSE concat(':', e.value) END)) END AS tags_array, tags AS tags_map FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1 ), runs AS (SELECT pipeline_id, update_id, MIN(period_start_time) AS create_time FROM system.lakeflow.pipeline_update_timeline GROUP BY pipeline_id, update_id), ev AS (SELECT *, coalesce(try_element_at(error.exceptions, 1).error_class, try_element_at(error.exceptions, 1).sql_state) AS ec FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events WHERE level = 'ERROR') SELECT p.pipeline_name AS `Pipeline Name`, p.pipeline_link AS `Pipeline Link`, e.update_id AS `Pipeline Run Id`, concat('', e.update_id, '') AS `Pipeline Run`, e.origin.dataset_name AS `Target Table`, r.create_time AS `Pipeline Run Start Time`, e.event_time AS `Error Time`, e.message AS `Error Message in Log`, nullif(concat_ws('; ', transform(coalesce(e.error.exceptions, array()), x -> coalesce(x.error_class, x.sql_state))), '') AS `Error Message`, (CASE WHEN e.ec IS NULL THEN '' WHEN e.ec = '' THEN '' ELSE e.ec END) AS `Error Code`, to_json(e.error) AS `Error Details` FROM ev e LEFT JOIN pipes p ON p.pipeline_id = e.pipeline_id LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.pipeline_id = e.pipeline_id AND r.update_id = e.update_id WHERE (:pipeline_id = 'All' OR e.pipeline_id = :pipeline_id) AND (e.event_time >= :event_range.min AND e.event_time <= :event_range.max) AND ((:pipeline_tag_value = '') OR (:pipeline_tag_value = '' AND (tags_array IS NULL OR array_size(tags_array) = 0)) OR array_contains(tags_array, :pipeline_tag_value)) ORDER BY e.event_time DESC

datasets.name: 19d796af
queryLines: WITH pipes AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, name AS pipeline_name, concat('', coalesce(name, pipeline_id), '') AS pipeline_link, pipeline_type, CASE WHEN tags IS NULL OR cardinality(tags) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE transform(map_entries(tags), e -> concat(e.key, CASE WHEN e.value IS NULL OR e.value = '' THEN '' ELSE concat(':', e.value) END)) END AS tags_array, tags AS tags_map FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1 ), runs AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, update_id AS pipeline_run_id, MIN(period_start_time) AS create_time, MAX(CASE WHEN result_state IS NOT NULL THEN period_end_time END) AS end_time, MAX(result_state) AS latest_state FROM system.lakeflow.pipeline_update_timeline GROUP BY pipeline_id, update_id), phases AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, update_id, min(CASE WHEN st = 'INITIALIZING' THEN event_time END) AS init_start, min(CASE WHEN st = 'RUNNING' THEN event_time END) AS run_start FROM (SELECT pipeline_id, update_id, event_time, upper(details:update_progress.state::string) AS st FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events WHERE event_type = 'update_progress') GROUP BY 1, 2), errs AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, update_id, max_by(message, event_time) AS err_log, max_by(nullif(concat_ws('; ', transform(coalesce(error.exceptions, array()), x -> coalesce(x.error_class, x.sql_state))), ''), event_time) AS err_msg, max_by(coalesce(try_element_at(error.exceptions, 1).error_class, try_element_at(error.exceptions, 1).sql_state), event_time) AS err_code, max_by(to_json(error), event_time) AS err_full, max(event_time) AS err_time FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events WHERE level = 'ERROR' GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT p.pipeline_link AS `Pipeline`, p.pipeline_name AS `Pipeline Name`, concat('', r.pipeline_run_id, '') AS `Pipeline run`, r.create_time AS `Create time`, r.end_time AS `End time`, r.latest_state AS `Status String`, concat('', coalesce(r.latest_state, '-'), '') AS `Status`, ifnull(er.err_log, '') AS `Latest error log message`, ifnull(er.err_msg, '') AS `Latest error message`, ifnull(er.err_code, '') AS `Latest error code`, er.err_full AS `Latest full error`, timestampdiff(second, r.create_time, ifnull(r.end_time, current_timestamp())) AS `Total seconds`, timestampdiff(second, r.create_time, ph.init_start) AS `Starting seconds`, timestampdiff(second, ph.init_start, ph.run_start) AS `Initialization seconds`, timestampdiff(second, ph.run_start, ifnull(r.end_time, current_timestamp())) AS `Running seconds` FROM runs r LEFT JOIN pipes p USING (pipeline_id) LEFT JOIN phases ph ON ph.pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id AND ph.update_id = r.pipeline_run_id LEFT JOIN errs er ON er.pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id AND er.update_id = r.pipeline_run_id WHERE (:pipeline_id = 'All' OR r.pipeline_id = :pipeline_id) AND ((r.create_time >= :event_range.min AND r.create_time <= :event_range.max) OR (r.end_time >= :event_range.min AND r.end_time <= :event_range.max)) AND ((:pipeline_tag_value = '') OR (:pipeline_tag_value = '' AND (tags_array IS NULL OR array_size(tags_array) = 0)) OR array_contains(tags_array, :pipeline_tag_value))

datasets.name: 5ef35e45
queryLines:
SELECT '<None>' AS tag_value
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT tv AS tag_value
FROM (
  SELECT explode(transform(map_entries(tags), e -> concat(e.key, CASE WHEN e.value IS NULL OR e.value = '' THEN '' ELSE concat(':', e.value) END))) AS tv
  FROM (SELECT tags FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines WHERE tags IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(tags) > 0
        QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1))

queryLines: WITH pipes AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, name AS pipeline_name, concat('', coalesce(name, pipeline_id), '') AS pipeline_link, pipeline_type, CASE WHEN tags IS NULL OR cardinality(tags) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE transform(map_entries(tags), e -> concat(e.key, CASE WHEN e.value IS NULL OR e.value = '' THEN '' ELSE concat(':', e.value) END)) END AS tags_array, tags AS tags_map FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1 ), runs AS (SELECT pipeline_id, update_id, MIN(period_start_time) AS create_time, MAX(CASE WHEN result_state IS NOT NULL THEN period_end_time END) AS end_time, MAX(result_state) AS result_state FROM system.lakeflow.pipeline_update_timeline GROUP BY pipeline_id, update_id), fp AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, update_id, origin.dataset_name AS dataset_name, event_time, details:flow_progress.status::string AS status FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events WHERE event_type = 'flow_progress' AND origin.dataset_name IS NOT NULL), latest_tbl AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, dataset_name, max_by(update_id, event_time) AS update_id, max_by(status, event_time) AS status, max(event_time) AS updated_at FROM fp GROUP BY 1, 2), latest_change AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, origin.dataset_name AS dataset_name, max(event_time) AS changes_time FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events WHERE event_type = 'flow_progress' AND origin.dataset_name IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(details:flow_progress.metrics.num_output_rows AS BIGINT) > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2), tbl_err AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, origin.dataset_name AS dataset_name, max_by(update_id, event_time) AS update_id, max_by(message, event_time) AS err_log, max_by(nullif(concat_ws('; queryLines: WITH pipes AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, name AS pipeline_name, concat('', coalesce(name, pipeline_id), '') AS pipeline_link, pipeline_type, CASE WHEN tags IS NULL OR cardinality(tags) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE transform(map_entries(tags), e -> concat(e.key, CASE WHEN e.value IS NULL OR e.value = '' THEN '' ELSE concat(':', e.value) END)) END AS tags_array, tags AS tags_map FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1 ), tabs AS (SELECT DISTINCT pipeline_id, origin.dataset_name AS table_name FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events WHERE origin.dataset_name IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.pipeline_link AS `Pipeline`, t.table_name AS `Target Table` FROM tabs t LEFT JOIN pipes p ON p.pipeline_id = t.pipeline_id WHERE (:pipeline_id = 'All' OR t.pipeline_id = :pipeline_id) AND (:table_name = 'All' OR t.table_name = :table_name) AND ((:pipeline_tag_value = '') OR (:pipeline_tag_value = '' AND (tags_array IS NULL OR array_size(tags_array) = 0)) OR array_contains(tags_array, :pipeline_tag_value))

datasets.name: 3b8b7d86
queryLines: WITH pipes AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, name AS pipeline_name, concat('', coalesce(name, pipeline_id), '') AS pipeline_link, pipeline_type, CASE WHEN tags IS NULL OR cardinality(tags) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE transform(map_entries(tags), e -> concat(e.key, CASE WHEN e.value IS NULL OR e.value = '' THEN '' ELSE concat(':', e.value) END)) END AS tags_array, tags AS tags_map FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1 ), runs AS (SELECT pipeline_id, update_id, MIN(period_start_time) AS create_time FROM system.lakeflow.pipeline_update_timeline GROUP BY pipeline_id, update_id), ev AS (SELECT *, coalesce(try_element_at(error.exceptions, 1).error_class, try_element_at(error.exceptions, 1).sql_state) AS ec FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events WHERE level = 'ERROR') SELECT p.pipeline_name AS `Pipeline Name`, p.pipeline_link AS `Pipeline Link`, e.update_id AS `Pipeline Run Id`, concat('', e.update_id, '') AS `Pipeline Run`, e.origin.dataset_name AS `Target Table`, r.create_time AS `Pipeline Start Time`, e.event_time AS `Error Time`, e.message AS `Error Log Message`, nullif(concat_ws('; ', transform(coalesce(e.error.exceptions, array()), x -> coalesce(x.error_class, x.sql_state))), '') AS `Error Message`, (CASE WHEN e.ec IS NULL THEN '' WHEN e.ec = '' THEN '' ELSE e.ec END) AS `Error Code`, to_json(e.error) AS `Error Details` FROM ev e LEFT JOIN pipes p ON p.pipeline_id = e.pipeline_id LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.pipeline_id = e.pipeline_id AND r.update_id = e.update_id WHERE (:pipeline_id = 'All' OR e.pipeline_id = :pipeline_id) AND (e.event_time >= :event_range.min AND e.event_time <= :event_range.max) AND (:table_name = 'All' OR e.origin.dataset_name = :table_name) AND e.origin.dataset_name IS NOT NULL AND ((:pipeline_tag_value = '') OR (:pipeline_tag_value = '' AND (tags_array IS NULL OR array_size(tags_array) = 0)) OR array_contains(tags_array, :pipeline_tag_value)) ORDER BY e.event_time DESC

datasets.name: 62d03d54
queryLines: WITH pipes AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, name AS pipeline_name, concat('', coalesce(name, pipeline_id), '') AS pipeline_link, pipeline_type, CASE WHEN tags IS NULL OR cardinality(tags) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE transform(map_entries(tags), e -> concat(e.key, CASE WHEN e.value IS NULL OR e.value = '' THEN '' ELSE concat(':', e.value) END)) END AS tags_array, tags AS tags_map FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1 ), runs AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, update_id, create_time, end_time, result_state, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY create_time DESC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT pipeline_id, update_id, MIN(period_start_time) AS create_time, MAX(CASE WHEN result_state IS NOT NULL THEN period_end_time END) AS end_time, MAX(result_state) AS result_state FROM system.lakeflow.pipeline_update_timeline GROUP BY pipeline_id, update_id)), cnts AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, update_id, sum(CASE WHEN level = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_err, sum(CASE WHEN level IN ('WARN', 'WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_warn FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events GROUP BY 1, 2), errs AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, update_id, max_by(message, event_time) AS err_log, max_by(nullif(concat_ws('; ', transform(coalesce(error.exceptions, array()), x -> coalesce(x.error_class, x.sql_state))), ''), event_time) AS err_msg, max_by(coalesce(try_element_at(error.exceptions, 1).error_class, try_element_at(error.exceptions, 1).sql_state), event_time) AS err_code, max_by(to_json(error), event_time) AS err_full, max(event_time) AS err_time FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events WHERE level = 'ERROR' GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT p.pipeline_link AS `Pipeline`, p.pipeline_name AS `Pipeline Name`, concat('', r.update_id, '') AS `Latest Pipeline Run`, r.create_time AS `Latest Create time`, r.end_time AS `Latest End time`, r.result_state AS `Latest Status String`, concat('', coalesce(r.result_state, '-'), '') AS `Latest Status`, ifnull(er.err_log, '') AS `Latest error log message`, ifnull(er.err_msg, '') AS `Latest error message`, ifnull(er.err_code, '') AS `Latest error code`, ifnull(c.n_err, 0) AS `Latest run errors`, ifnull(c.n_warn, 0) AS `Latest run warnings`, timestampdiff(second, r.create_time, ifnull(r.end_time, current_timestamp())) AS `Latest Total Seconds`, r.end_time AS `Last Updated` FROM runs r LEFT JOIN pipes p USING (pipeline_id) LEFT JOIN cnts c ON c.pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id AND c.update_id = r.update_id LEFT JOIN errs er ON er.pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id AND er.update_id = r.update_id WHERE r.rn = 1 AND (:pipeline_id = 'All' OR r.pipeline_id = :pipeline_id) AND ((r.create_time >= :event_range.min AND r.create_time <= :event_range.max) OR (r.end_time >= :event_range.min AND r.end_time <= :event_range.max)) AND ((:pipeline_tag_value = '') OR (:pipeline_tag_value = '' AND (tags_array IS NULL OR array_size(tags_array) = 0)) OR array_contains(tags_array, :pipeline_tag_value))

datasets.name: flow_outcomes
queryLines: WITH pipes AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, name AS pipeline_name, concat('', coalesce(name, pipeline_id), '') AS pipeline_link, pipeline_type, CASE WHEN tags IS NULL OR cardinality(tags) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE transform(map_entries(tags), e -> concat(e.key, CASE WHEN e.value IS NULL OR e.value = '' THEN '' ELSE concat(':', e.value) END)) END AS tags_array, tags AS tags_map FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1 ) SELECT e.details:flow_progress.status::string AS status, approx_count_distinct(coalesce(e.update_id, '') || '|' || coalesce(e.origin.flow_id, e.origin.flow_name, '')) AS flow_runs FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events e LEFT JOIN pipes p ON p.pipeline_id = e.pipeline_id WHERE e.event_type = 'flow_progress' AND e.details:flow_progress.status::string IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED', 'STOPPED', 'EXCLUDED') AND (:pipeline_id = 'All' OR e.pipeline_id = :pipeline_id) AND (e.event_time >= :event_range.min AND e.event_time <= :event_range.max) AND ((:pipeline_tag_value = '') OR (:pipeline_tag_value = '' AND (tags_array IS NULL OR array_size(tags_array) = 0)) OR array_contains(tags_array, :pipeline_tag_value)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY flow_runs DESC

datasets.name: hygiene
queryLines: WITH pipes AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, name AS pipeline_name, concat('', coalesce(name, pipeline_id), '') AS pipeline_link, pipeline_type, CASE WHEN tags IS NULL OR cardinality(tags) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE transform(map_entries(tags), e -> concat(e.key, CASE WHEN e.value IS NULL OR e.value = '' THEN '' ELSE concat(':', e.value) END)) END AS tags_array, tags AS tags_map FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1 ) SELECT e.event_type || ': ' || COALESCE(e.details:deprecation.feature::string, e.details:unsupported_operation.operation::string, e.details:advisory.subject::string, '-') AS item, count(*) AS events FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events e LEFT JOIN pipes p ON p.pipeline_id = e.pipeline_id WHERE e.event_type IN ('deprecation', 'unsupported_operation', 'advisory') AND (:pipeline_id = 'All' OR e.pipeline_id = :pipeline_id) AND (e.event_time >= :event_range.min AND e.event_time <= :event_range.max) AND ((:pipeline_tag_value = '') OR (:pipeline_tag_value = '' AND (tags_array IS NULL OR array_size(tags_array) = 0)) OR array_contains(tags_array, :pipeline_tag_value)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 12

datasets.name: dd_util
queryLines: WITH pipes AS ( SELECT pipeline_id, name AS pipeline_name, concat('', coalesce(name, pipeline_id), '') AS pipeline_link, pipeline_type, CASE WHEN tags IS NULL OR cardinality(tags) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE transform(map_entries(tags), e -> concat(e.key, CASE WHEN e.value IS NULL OR e.value = '' THEN '' ELSE concat(':', e.value) END)) END AS tags_array, tags AS tags_map FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1 ) SELECT CASE WHEN :param_util_grain = 'hour' THEN date_trunc('HOUR', e.event_time) ELSE date_trunc('MINUTE', e.event_time) END AS ts, CASE WHEN :param_util_groupby = 'per cluster (pod)' THEN COALESCE(e.origin.cluster_id, '(unknown)') ELSE 'all clusters' END AS cluster, avg(TRY_CAST(e.details:cluster_resources.task_slot_metrics.avg_task_slot_utilization AS DOUBLE)) * 100 AS slot_utilization_pct FROM system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events e LEFT JOIN pipes p ON p.pipeline_id = e.pipeline_id WHERE e.event_type = 'cluster_resources' AND (:pipeline_id = 'All' OR e.pipeline_id = :pipeline_id) AND (e.event_time >= :event_range.min AND e.event_time <= :event_range.max) AND ((:pipeline_tag_value = '') OR (:pipeline_tag_value = '' AND (tags_array IS NULL OR array_size(tags_array) = 0)) OR array_contains(tags_array, :pipeline_tag_value)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY ts

queryLines: SELECT grain FROM VALUES ('minute', 0), ('hour', 1) AS t(grain, ord) ORDER BY ord

datasets.name: util_groupby
